entries.title: 🎟️ Pick Values + Clearer Grades
notes: 🎟️ Draft picks no longer lose value for taking up a roster spot, so trades with picks grade a little friendlier to the side getting them.
📅 Picks further out lose a bit more per year: a 1st now is worth next year's 1st + 2nd.
🔎 Trade grade previews now always match the full breakdown. If a trade's grade has changed since it was proposed, you'll see the original grade right below it.

entries.title: 📌 Your Matchup, Front and Center
notes: 📌 NEW: your own matchup is pinned at the very top of Standings, so you don't have to find it. Your team is always listed first.
👤 Tap any player's name in a lineup to open their player card.
🧮 Tap a player's points to see how they scored them, like 9 receptions for +9 and 145 receiving yards for +14.5. It updates live during the game.
⤢ Both work in the full-screen view too.

entries.title: 📡 Live Win Probability
notes: 📊 NEW: every matchup on This Week shows each team's live chance to win, with a bar that moves as the games go. It's the same number the ESPN app shows.
🔮 Under each score is the live projected total, and every player shows a faded projection under their points that updates during their game.
🏈 Open a matchup to see each player's game: score, clock, and kickoff time. Players whose team has the ball are highlighted yellow, and red when in the red zone.
⤢ Tap Full Screen in an open matchup for an ESPN-style view that keeps your phone awake, plus a chart of how the win % has swung while you watched.
⚡ Scores refresh every 15 seconds while NFL games are on, and flash green when they go up.
🏆 Standings now highlight the top 6 teams, matching the 6 playoff spots.

entries.title: 🔧 Updates Load Cleanly
notes: 🛠️ FIXED: after an update, some devices showed a half-old, half-new page (wrong Standings layout, flickering). Updates now load all at once.
⚡ The app no longer loads twice on your first visit.
🧭 Includes the 1.21 Standings redesign: This Week first, a collapsible story, the new desktop layout, and the Compact layout (tap the W logo to switch).

entries.title: 🧭 A Cleaner Standings Page
notes: 📐 New Compact layout: tap the W logo in the top corner to switch. Tighter rows, smaller photos, more on screen. Tap it again to go back. Your choice is saved on this device.
🏈 This Week's scores now come right after the headline. Leaderboard and the Luck Index follow.
📰 Collapse the weekly story to just its headline with the − button. A new week's story still opens once so you don't miss it.
🖥️ Desktop: matchups fill the width, and the Luck chart sits beside the Leaderboard and follows you as you scroll.
🛠️ FIXED: the page no longer jumps around while loading, and live scores refresh without flickering.

entries.title: 🗣️ Who's Winning?
notes: 🗣️ Every trade grade now says it plainly: "Kyla is fleecing Zack", "Zack is slightly winning", or "Even trade. Nobody's winning this one."
🔍 Trade Finder and Shop show more ideas: anything short of a fleece, fairest deals first.
🚫 Fleeces are still never suggested.

entries.title: 📊 Win-Now Rankings + Smarter Projections
notes: 📊 NEW: This Season value. See how strong every starting lineup is right now, next to dynasty value, on My Team, Rosters and in the Vault.
🏆 Vault leaderboards: switch between Dynasty, This Season and In 3 Years.
🔮 Smarter 3-year projections: picks gain value as the draft nears, active traders trend up, and old rosters with few picks fall off harder.
🔧 FIXED: picks listed under a team's old name now show the current team and get their proper value.
🔧 FIXED: a roster getting older now counts as a minus in trade suggestions.

entries.title: 📜 Patch Notes + Smarter Fits
notes: 📜 NEW: Patch Notes. Read every update and when it shipped (find it at the bottom of My Team).
🧠 Trade Finder fits now match team mode: Rebuilders hold onto picks and youth, Contenders turn picks into help now.
📝 Every suggestion lists the specific reasons it works for each side, plus the fairness bar at a glance.
🔘 Bigger Find buttons so they're easy to spot.

entries.title: 🛒 Shop Your Players
notes: 🛒 NEW in the Trade Finder: Shop my players. Pick up to 3 players or picks you're selling and see what every team could offer that's fair.
🎚️ Choose what you'll take back (players, picks, or both) and how many pieces (1, 2 or 3).
✓ Best fits first, with why each team would say yes. One tap loads an offer into a proposal.

entries.title: 🍀 Luck, Fixed
notes: 🛠️ FIXED: the Schedule Luck chart had its up/down flipped, so teams landed in the wrong quadrant. Same fix in the Vault's Career Luck Matrix.
🍀 New luck badge on every team: wins above (+) or below (−) what your weekly scores earned.
🔍 Crowded luck charts now spread teams apart. A small dot and line show each team's exact spot.
📋 Trade Block players now show their value and stats. Tap a card to open the full profile.

entries.title: 🔍 Smarter Trade Finder
notes: 🔍 Trade Finder only suggests deals that help BOTH teams. No more pointless pick-for-pick swaps.
🎚️ New filters: choose players or picks on each side, and deal size (1 for 1, 2 for 1, 1 for 2, 2 for 2).
💬 Every idea explains why it helps you and why they'd say yes, plus player headshots.
🎯 FIXED: draft picks for a couple of teams weren't getting their early/mid/late value. Pick values now step smoothly by slot.

entries.title: 📰 League Trade Feed
notes: 📰 NEW on the Trades tab: League Trade Feed. Every accepted trade and what the calculator said about it, open to everyone.
🔎 See the math: tap any trade in the feed for the full breakdown. See if it still holds today.
⚖️ Your incoming and outgoing offers on My Team now show a grade. Tap to expand the full analysis.

entries.title: 🏆 Team Value Leaderboard
notes: 🏆 NEW in the Vault: Team Value. See every roster ranked by total dynasty value.
📈 Projected Team Value chart: see whose roster is rising and whose is aging out over the next 3 years.
💰 Your team's total value, league rank, pick value and 3-year outlook now sit at the bottom of My Team and Rosters.
✕ New Clear Trade button on the Trades tab to start a proposal over.

entries.title: 🛡️ Custom Logos Fixed
notes: 🖼️ Custom team logos now load. The app keeps its own copy, refreshed nightly.
⭐ Your team logo now sits next to your name on My Team.

entries.title: 🎨 Fresh Coat of Paint
notes: 🏈 Tap any matchup in This Week to see both lineups, player by player.
🛡️ Team logos now show on the leaderboard, scores, rosters, and trade dropdowns.
📸 Player headshots in the trade builder.
🔽 Every dropdown in the app got a new look, with search on long lists.
🛠️ FIXED: records and points no longer spill off the leaderboard cards.

entries.title: 📈 Values on Every Player Card
notes: 💎 Every player card in My Team and Rosters now shows their trade value, with ▲▼ when it's moving.
🛠️ FIXED: PPG and consistency now use every week of the season, not just last week.
📊 FIXED: weekly performance bars in player profiles now show every week at the right height.

entries.title: 🚨 The Trade Calculator Is HERE!
notes: 🏈 Our biggest update ever: every trade now gets a grade.
⚖️ FAIRNESS METER: see instantly if a deal is Fair, a Slight Edge, Lopsided or a FLEECE.
📊 Real values from FantasyCalc + DynastyProcess, updated daily and tuned to OUR scoring.
⭐ Stacking bench guys never adds up to a stud. Getting the best player counts.
🔍 TRADE FINDER: fair deals that help BOTH teams, loaded with one tap.
👤 PLAYER PROFILES: dynasty value, 3-year outlook, NFL contract, injury history and more.
👍👎 Rate any grade to help tune it. Now go make some moves! 🔥

entries.title: Beta 1.11.1 - Pick Values
notes: Draft picks: a pick now is worth more than a pick later. Picks after next year's draft lose 15% per year out
Next year's picks are valued early, mid or late from each team's projected finish
Tap 👍 or 👎 under any trade grade to tell the commissioner if it feels right

entries.title: Beta 1.11 - Trade Calculator
notes: New fairness meter on every trade: see at a glance whether a deal is Fair, a Slight edge, Lopsided, or a Fleece
Values blend FantasyCalc and DynastyProcess, refreshed daily and tuned to our scoring (TE premium, 6-pt passing TDs, 3 FLEX)
Getting the best player counts: stacking bench pieces no longer adds up to a stud
Trade Finder suggests fair deals that help both teams
Player profiles now show dynasty value, age outlook, NFL contract, injury history and stats

entries.title: Beta 1.10 - Archive & Analytics
notes: Fixed a bug where player PPG calculations were only using 1 week of data
Added a Newsletter Archive to view past weekly recaps
Fixed Front Page sorting to correctly display the newest release

entries.title: Beta 1.9 - Trade Block Fix
notes: Live Sunday scoring enabled
Standings tab auto-refreshes every 30 seconds
Fixed a visibility bug where private interest alerts prevented owners from listing players on the block.

entries.title: Beta 1.8 - Live Scoring
notes: Live Sunday scoring enabled
Standings tab auto-refreshes every 30 seconds

entries.title: Beta 1.7 - Trade Security & Refresh
notes: Strict role security: proposers can only cancel, receivers can accept or decline
Counteroffer engine: pre-loads and inverts existing offers for fast tweaking
Instant update detection with one-tap hard refresh

entries.title: Version 1.7.0
notes: Trade Security, Counteroffers, and Auto-Refresh
